name: Air-Fryer Mince Pies
subtitle: Crisp pastry cases filled with spiced vegetarian mincemeat
description: Small mince pies baked in an air fryer until golden and fully set, then finished with icing sugar.

instructions.text: Lightly flour the work surface. Roll the pastry to a thick, even sheet and cut rounds large enough to line 12 small pie molds.
Press the pastry rounds into the molds. Spoon the mincemeat into each case, leaving room for a pastry top.
Roll the remaining pastry and cut 12 lids. Whisk the egg, brush the pastry edges, add the lids, and press to seal. Cut a small vent in each top and brush with more egg.
Transfer the pies to the air fryer and chill if needed while preparing the remaining pies.
Preheat the air fryer. Arrange the pies in the basket in a single layer, working in batches if necessary.
Air-fry for about 10 minutes, or until the pastry is golden and the centers are firm and fully set; the egg-containing filling should reach 160°F on a food thermometer.
Cool the pies for 5 minutes, then dust with icing sugar before serving.
